title: Green Rewards Card: Earning Rewards on Eco-Friendly Purchases
summary: This document explains Green Rewards Card cash back earning: 3.0% on purchases at sustainable/eco-friendly merchants and 1.0% on all other eligible purchases. It covers how rewards accrue (per transaction consolidated at account level), what’s eligible/ineligible (e.g., cash equivalents, balance transfers, certain fees), and how to track and filter rewards in the rewards dashboard.
faqs: What cash back rate do I earn on sustainable/eco-friendly merchants vs other purchases?
How are Green Rewards tracked and consolidated on my account?
Which types of purchases do NOT earn rewards (e.g., cash equivalents, balance transfers, certain fees)?
What happens to rewards if a transaction is reversed or refunded?
How can I view and filter rewards by merchant category in the rewards dashboard?
What steps should I take to maximize earnings using the Green Rewards Card?
